tenderSchedule.title: ESTABLISHMENT AND COMMISSIONING OF 3.00 MLD STP AT BSBP
tenderSchedule.description: ESTABLISHMENT AND COMMISSIONING OF 3.00 MLD CAPACITY TERTIARY SEWAGE TREATMENT PLANT AT KSIIDC BENGALURU SIGNATURE BUSINESS PARK (BSBP) NEAR DEVANAHALLI, BENGALURU ON TURNKEY BASIS INCLUDING OPERATION AND MAINTAINANCE OF THE TREATMENT PLANT FOR A PERIOD OF 5 YEARS
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation

tenderAddress.blockNumber: KSIIDC, 4th Floor, Khanija Bhavana, East Wing, Race Course Road

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Work Completion or Execution Period 11 Months

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Work Completion or Execution Period 11 Months

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
All other terms and Conditions are as per tender documents
Tenderer shall be any individual, firm, agency shall be a Class I contractor registered with NH, KPWD, CPWD, or other Central/State Government undertaking with qualifications.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

The Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year(both days inclusive)

The Tenderer shall scan the Original Ownership Documents or Lease or Hire commitment Agreement for the Machinery and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
The Corporation is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal
Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible will only be considered for evaluation

The items quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials and other taxes as per the rates prevailing Govt Orders at the time of execution and including all the cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipments, etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work
Department or Corporation will not supply any materials
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable

The Tenderer must be present during opening of tender and submit uploaded documents duly attested by Gazzeted Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer and also produce original documents for confirmation at the time of opening.

The contractors are instructed to submit only relevant information with records as required and specified in qualification criteria. Any junk, superfluous and unnecessary documents if uploaded will treated as misleading and such tenders are liable to be rejected
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes (excluding GST) as per prevailing Government Orders

The bidder shall quote the amount for the work and the Operation & Maintenance (O&M) separately on the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal. A detailed cost breakdown, as per the Price Schedule, shall be submitted to this office at the time of opening the financial bid.

technicalCriterionList.description: Applicant shall provide evidence that it has successfully completed Design and construction of at least one similar contract of value not less than INR 10.21 Crores in last Five (5) years. The similarity shall be based on the physical size, complexity, methods, technology or other characteristics as described in Section 7 (Specifications).

The Applicant as a sole entity shall have successfully executed contracts(s) which includes, complete Design, Procurement, Supply, Installation, Construction, Testing, and Commissioning of all Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Instrumentation Works of Minimum One (1) Nos. Sewage Pumping Station of at least 1.5 MLD or more (Average flow) capacity.

Applicant shall also provide evidence that it has successfully completed the Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of at least one similar project contract of value not less than INR 0.25 Crore per annum in any last Five (5) years
Documents of Class I contractor registered with NH, KPWD,CPWD, or other Central/State Government
Availability by owned & Hired of the required or specified key and critical equipment for this work (Clause 3.1.5 (a) & (b)
